bead.title: Implement postgres relational typed secondary indexes
bead.description: Implement ADR-011 typed secondary index parity for postgres relational storage, which currently returns EngineError::Unavailable for index reads. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-postgres/src/relational.rs, postgres schema/migrations, postgres tests/conformance. Add pqueue_item_indexes or equivalent table storing canonical axon_esf index_key bytes plus metadata for unique/non-unique lookup. Maintain rows on push, replace_pending, update_fields, purge, and reopen. Enforce unique conflicts before durable mutation. Use env-gated postgres tests consistently with existing project pattern. Out-of-scope: sqlite implementation already handled by dependency.
bead.acceptance: cargo test -p pqueue-postgres --tests -- --nocapture passes in no-DB skip mode; with PQUEUE_PG_TEST_URL set, postgres typed index conformance passes; tests prove postgres no longer returns Unavailable for typed index query and unique conflicts are atomic.
